title: the DEFINE-stage guidance pack
description: User story under REQ-182. The guidance pack prints its slugs through `rcf guidance`, the MCP server advertises every argument-free DEFINE prompt, the register scan protects every new file from em-dashes, and the managed block regeneration never removes an existing rule.
iWant: the DEFINE-stage guidance pack served through one surface
soThat: the loop reads one slug per topic and the register scans and managed-block rules apply everywhere

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] given the pack, when rcf guidance define-intent and rcf guidance discovery-prototypes run, then each prints its file.

[happy] given the manifest, when the MCP server lists prompts, then rcf_define_intent, rcf_define_intake, rcf_define_draft_shapes, rcf_define_litmus and rcf_discover_prototype are present and argument-free.
[failure] given a new guidance file containing an em-dash, when the register scan runs, then it fails.
[must-not] given the managed block, when regenerated, then no existing rule is removed.
